_comment: THE AUTONOMOUS HALF of test/combo_off/aa_co_17 (seed 12345681 T3, USER 2026-11-19: 'A T3 win is possible
and we fail to reach it'). The same mid-turn board -- Brindle Boar already sacrificed (X = 4), Crab Umbra on the untapped
Alchemist, nothing else to tap, Staff of Domination in hand, Stroke 17 cards down -- at the deck's play setting (d5 b20).
The win needs the Umbra loop to bank the Staff's {3} with the Alchemist left untapped (ComputeUntapLoopNeed (f),
kLoopPayCastDraw), then the Staff, then the loop's draws to the Stroke. Before MTG_AA_LOOP_CAST_DRAW no loop was offered
and the engine won T4 at every budget (budget 0 included).
